research_question: Can an explicitly pricing-aware neural objective repair the alpha instability of the rejected Sharpe-only teacher without destroying its high-Sharpe risk direction?
objective: negative annualized teacher-factor Sharpe plus penalty times standardized analytic-scale Euler pricing-moment loss plus scaled-HHI regularization
penalty_selection_rule: Use 2000-2009 validation only: choose the smallest combined-74 HJ ridge distance among candidates whose factor Sharpe is at least 1.5; break ties by lower mean absolute alpha, then the smaller penalty.
development_use: 2010-2019 is exploratory confirmation of the selected penalty and does not alter the penalty choice.
next_gate: If the selected penalty improves development HJ distance and mean absolute alpha while retaining factor Sharpe, rerun that fixed penalty for all five predeclared seeds before adding IPCA and model-out double sorts.
